_comment: Race mode (card 06). gridSec = time on the grid before the lights; lights come on one per lightIntervalSec, then a random hold of holdMinSec..holdMaxSec before lights out. Throttle above jumpStartThrottle while the lights are on = jump start (flagged on the results, no penalty yet). finishTimeoutSec = how long after the winner the race waits for stragglers.
